metadata.chronas:note: Token-free replacement for mapbox://styles/mapbox/empty-v9. Renders no basemap; Chronas draws its own province/marker layers on top. Glyphs are declared so our own symbol layers (area labels) can resolve fonts, but nothing reaches OpenFreeMap: every fontstack Chronas references is in LOCAL_FONT_NAMES and rewritten to public/fonts/ by MapView's transformRequest.
metadata.chronas:note-projection: Chronas has a round world. MapLibre resets the projection to stylesheet.projection ?? mercator on every style load, so declaring it here is what makes the globe survive a basemap switch.
